source_filter: phase == 'phase1' and metrics_available == True; complex rows identified by run_label prefix complex_ or cx_, real baseline identified by run_label == 'real'

plotting_conventions.domain_encoding: Image uses filled circles in blue; Fourier uses open triangles in orange
plotting_conventions.marker_size: small; Image mark size 1.35pt; Fourier mark size 1.55pt
plotting_conventions.coordinates: actual metric coordinates only; no jitter
plotting_conventions.reference_lines: vertical at exact real baseline AUC and horizontal at exact real baseline AP; dashed gray
plotting_conventions.legend: placed above the plotting region; no configuration labels, regression lines, or quadrant labels
plotting_conventions.caption: Joint distribution of test AUC and average precision across the 480 complex-valued configurations. Image-domain and Fourier-domain configurations are distinguished by marker style; dashed reference lines denote the fixed real magnitude baseline in AUC and average precision.

summary_interpretation: Descriptive properties of the finite factorial grid; no population inference.
